definition.ps: دا د طبي زده کړې لنډه تشریح ده: Inflammation of the vermiform appendix.
definition.fa: خلاصه آموزشی: Inflammation of the vermiform appendix.

explanation.en: Appendicitis commonly causes abdominal pain and can require urgent assessment because untreated inflammation may lead to serious complications.
